desc: A SEALED SCROLL of old yellowed parchment, rolled up and tied with a faded cord, a big round dark-red WAX SEAL, standing slightly tilted on one end. an ancient sacred relic of the first ten humans, small, weathered and very old, seen from the high three-quarter top-down game camera, standing upright on its own (no stand, no table, no ground) as it would sit on a small offering tray.
